paper.title_en: Comments on Symmetry Operators, Asymptotic Charges and Soft Theorems
paper.abstract_en: We study the relation between emergent 1-form symmetries and soft photon theorems in QED. We show that in the relevant massive and massless kinematic regimes, described respectively by HQET and SCET, the soft sector admits electric and magnetic 1-form symmetries. We then show that these symmetries give rise to an infinite-dimensional Abelian algebra of ordinary conserved charges, with a central extension. In Minkowski spacetime, suitable choices of hypersurfaces reduce these charges to the familiar asymptotic symmetry charges and imply the leading electric and magnetic soft photon theorems. We further show that the central term in this algebra fixes a contact term appearing in scattering amplitudes involving two soft photons with mixed electric-magnetic polarizations. Finally, we extend the same construction to inclusive observables and apply it to QED photon detectors.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了QED中的对称性算子、渐近电荷与软定理之间的关系，属于广义相对论基础中的渐近对称性范畴，理论深度高，方法严谨，具有新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 关于对称性算子、渐近电荷和软定理的评论
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了QED中涌现的1-形式对称性与软光子定理之间的关系。我们证明，在相关的有质量和无质量运动学区域中（分别由HQET和SCET描述），软扇区允许电和磁1-形式对称性。然后我们证明，这些对称性产生了一个无限维的交换普通守恒荷代数，并带有中心扩展。在闵可夫斯基时空中，合适的超曲面选择将这些荷约化为熟悉的渐近对称性荷，并推导出leading电和磁软光子定理。我们进一步证明，该代数中的中心项固定了涉及两个混合电-磁极化软光子的散射振幅中出现的接触项。最后，我们将相同的构造扩展到包含可观测量，并将其应用于QED光子探测器。
